name: Porbandar

routes.outcome: Official District Porbandar land-records page states that cadastral survey underlies Gujarat land records, identifies e-Dhara/Mamlatdar offices, and links AnyRoR.
Current official HTML loaded; AnyRoR link extracted. No parcel geometry endpoint or map JavaScript was exposed on this page.
Anonymous TLS GET timed out after 20 seconds; no login, CAPTCHA, unsafe field request, or TLS bypass was attempted.

Official DILRMP page identifies Gujarat, Porbandar district and Porbandar tehsil: 83/83 maps digitized, 77/77 villages spatially verified, 77/77 cadastral maps geo-referenced and linked to RoR, and 80,208 parcels geo-referenced. This is coverage evidence only.
Direct curl rejected the host certificate chain; TLS verification was not disabled and no exception was authorized. The indexed official result was used only for the status values above.
Official Gujarat Revenue Department page identifies IORA services including View Land Records (7/12), Property Cards, and related revenue services.
Anonymous GET timed out after 12 seconds; no credentials or unsafe data fields were requested.
Official NIC implementation-status page loaded and lists Gujarat under CollabLand, not a public Gujarat parcel viewer/API.
NIC Bhu-Naksha documentation describes the national cadastral software as primarily an authorized state/operator system; no Porbandar public endpoint was identified.

qualification.reason: Registry custodian and district coverage are evidenced, but parcel endpoint availability, exact-point membership, native identity semantics, citywide completeness, adapter behavior, and geometry CRS remain unqualified.

uncertainty: Official first-party custodian and Porbandar taluka digitization coverage are verified. Public AnyRoR/IORA retrieval was unavailable in bounded requests, and no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. Runtime readiness remains held pending serial qualification.
